title: Supplemental exact-field disposition for native ordinary translation backcheck
authority: Rory authorized regional ordinary translation with canonical English unchanged. This supplement carries no fluency certification and imposes no prepublication human-approval gate.
registryAuthority: lib/course-localization.ts assembles the source-paired regional learner drafts against lib/course-modules.ts. Current source and target values are bound by candidateIndex in the supplied native ordinary inventory and triage; native registry file is given for each field.

summary.scope: Only the seven fields named in this supplement are re-disposed. The prior report is not rewritten; the two no-op fields are explicitly excluded from release, and five fields receive precise repair targets.

fieldDispositions.sourceEnglish: If a treatment is needed, use a product registered for that crop and pest, and follow its label. This includes neem products. Check protection and harvest waiting instructions. Do not improvise mixtures or stronger doses.
fieldDispositions.currentTarget: Ha treatment e hlokahala, sebedisa product registered for that crop and pest, mme o latele label ya yona. Sena se kenyeletsa neem products. Hlahloba protection and harvest waiting instructions. Do not improvise mixtures or stronger doses.
fieldDispositions.previousProposal: Ha treatment e hlokahala, sebedisa product registered for that crop and pest mme o latele label ya yona. Sena se kenyeletsa neem products. Hlahloba protection and harvest waiting instructions. O se ke wa itirela metswako kapa wa sebedisa stronger doses.
fieldDispositions.reason: Keep one negative instruction governing both coordinated objects. The source says not to improvise mixtures or stronger doses; it does not separately ban using every stronger dose irrespective of whether it is improvised.
fieldDispositions.supplementalTarget: Ha treatment e hlokahala, sebedisa product registered for that crop and pest mme o latele label ya yona. Sena se kenyeletsa neem products. Hlahloba protection and harvest waiting instructions. O se ke wa itirela metswako kapa stronger doses.
fieldDispositions.backTranslation: Do not make up mixtures or stronger doses.
fieldDispositions.targetEditScope: Replace only the final sentence; preserve every preceding localized and English technical/safety clause exactly as in previousProposal.

fieldDispositions.sourceEnglish: A pest on a leaf, and three ways to deal with it without chemicals: a beneficial insect, a physical barrier, and picking it off by hand.
fieldDispositions.currentTarget: A pest on a leaf, and three ways to deal with it without chemicals: a beneficial insect, a physical barrier, and picking it off by hand.
fieldDispositions.previousProposal: Pest e lekhasi, le ditsela tse tharo tsa ho e laola ntle le dikhemikhale: kokoanyana e molemo, physical barrier, le ho e tlosa ka letsoho.
fieldDispositions.reason: Add the locative relation “on a leaf”; “Pest e lekhasi” can read as the pest being the leaf. “E holim’a lekhasi” back-translates as on top of a leaf and preserves the rest of the illustration description.
fieldDispositions.supplementalTarget: Pest e holim'a lekhasi, le ditsela tse tharo tsa ho e laola ntle le dikhemikhali: kokoanyana e molemo, physical barrier, le ho e tlosa ka letsoho.
fieldDispositions.backTranslation: A pest on a leaf, and three ways to deal with it without chemicals: a beneficial insect, a physical barrier, and picking it off by hand.

fieldDispositions.sourceEnglish: Whether it's actually a soil nutrient or watering issue
fieldDispositions.currentTarget: Loko hakunene ku ri soil nutrient or watering issue
fieldDispositions.previousProposal: Loko hakunene ku ri xiphiqo xa swakudya swa misava kumbe xa ku cheleta
fieldDispositions.reason: Retain “soil nutrient” as the technical phrase; translate the ordinary “issue” frame and “watering”. The alternative remains open as a whether-clause and is not recast as an asserted condition.
fieldDispositions.supplementalTarget: Loko hakunene ku ri xiphiqo xa soil nutrient kumbe xa ku cheleta
fieldDispositions.backTranslation: Whether it really is a soil nutrient problem or a watering problem.
